papers.title: ANALYSE MULTIVARIÉE DES PROFILS ÉPIDÉMIOLOGIQUES DE LA MPOX À L’ÉCHELLE INTERNATIONALE PAR ANALYSE EN COMPOSANTES PRINCIPALES : Positionnement de la République Démocratique du Congo
papers.abstract: This paper presents a descriptive multivariate analysis of international mpox epidemiological profiles using principal component analysis (PCA). The dataset was obtained from the Our World in Data mpox database, derived from World Health Organization data, and covers the period from 1 May 2022 to 28 February 2026. After removing regional and global aggregates, checking ISO codes, handling missing values, and constructing country-level indicators, 144 countries and territories were retained. Fifteen variables describing cumulative burden, mortality, peak intensity, temporal dispersion, and duration of circulation were analyzed. Bartlett’s test of sphericity (χ2 = 2972.55; p < 0.001) and the overall KMO index (0.668) supported the use of exploratory PCA. The first three components explained 71.55% of the total variance. The first component mainly represented observed intensity and severity, the second duration and persistence of circulation, and the third the contrast between case burden and death burden. The applied contribution of the study lies in transforming daily surveillance series into a reproducible country-by-indicator matrix and positioning the Democratic Republic of the Congo within the international factorial space. The Democratic Republic of the Congo had a high PC1 score and a positive PC2 score, consistent with a profile of high reported burden and sustained circulation. This interpretation remains descriptive and depends on the quality of national surveillance systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 本文采用主成分分析(PCA)对国际猴痘流行病学特征进行了描述性多变量分析。数据集来源于Our World in Data 猴痘数据库,该数据库基于世界卫生组织数据,涵盖2022年5月1日至2026年2月28日的时间段。在去除区域和全球汇总数据、检查ISO代码、处理缺失值并构建国家层面指标后,保留了144个国家和地区。分析了15个变量,包括累积负担、死亡率、峰值强度、时间分散性和传播持续时间。巴特利特球形度检验(χ2 = 2972.55;p < 0.001)和总体KMO指数(0.668)支持了探索性PCA的应用。前三个主成分解释了总方差的71.55%。第一个主成分主要代表观察到的强度和严重程度,第二个主成分代表传播的持续时间和持久性,第三个主成分则代表病例负担与死亡负担之间的对比。本研究的贡献在于将每日监测系列数据转化为可重复的国家-指标矩阵,并将刚果民主共和国定位在国际因子空间中。刚果民主共和国具有较高的PC1得分和正的PC2得分,与高报告负担和持续传播的特征一致。这种解释仍保持描述性,并依赖于国家监测系统的质量。

Volume 32, Supplement –Summer 2026 SUPPLEMENT ISSUE Supplement Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025 Cite This Article Citation for Media Abstract In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response. Since the first case was identified in a nonendemic region, mpox has emerged as an increasing public health concern in the United States. The global outbreak in 2022 affected 75 countries and territories; >2,300 cases had been confirmed in the United States by July 2022 (1). Because of evolving transmission dynamics, severity, and uncertainty surrounding social and economic impacts, the World Health Organization declared mpox a public health emergency of international concern on July 23, 2022 (2–3). Mpox is an infectious disease endemic to regions of Central and West Africa. It is caused by the enveloped DNA virus monkeypox virus (MPXV) and is characterized by fever, headache, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, and a vesiculopustular rash that can involve the face, extremities, and genital region (3). Mpox is primarily transmitted through direct contact with active lesions, contaminated materials, bodily fluids, or respiratory transmission at close range (4,5). Mpox infections are categorized into 2 genetically distinct clades, clade I and clade II. Clade II infections, which were responsible for the global outbreak that began in 2022, are generally associated with less severe disease and reduced transmissibility (5). Historically, clade I mpox infections have demonstrated greater virulence, mortality, and transmission (6). The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Wastewater Surveillance System initiated wastewater testing for MPXV in October 2022, five months after the mpox outbreak began in the United States. For underreported and stigmatized infections such as mpox, traditional case-based surveillance can present challenges, including incomplete capture of subclinical or unreported cases, making wastewater surveillance a valuable complementary approach to clinical mpox surveillance (5,6). Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). Studies have also documented correlations between wastewater MPXV concentrations and incident mpox cases within corresponding sewersheds, supporting the utility of wastewater surveillance as a proxy for community-level transmission (10). Finally, wastewater detections in areas without corresponding clinical reports may help identify communities where mpox transmission might otherwise remain undetected because of social stigma, limited clinical recognition, or constrained diagnostic capacity (5,9). Recognizing wastewater surveillance as a valuable strategy for early identification of infectious disease activity, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (NCDHHS) integrated mpox monitoring into its statewide wastewater surveillance program. In September 2023, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at selected wastewater surveillance sites across the state. That assay detects orthopoxviruses including vaccinia, cowpox, and all clades of MPXV. Primary sites were facilities in Asheville, Charlotte, Greensboro, Greenville, and Raleigh; additional periodic testing was conducted at selected sites in Cary, Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham. To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. For the period October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, we compared wastewater detections from the North Carolina Wastewater Monitoring Network, operated by the NCDHHS, with confirmed clinical mpox cases using a +17-day temporal window. We assumed clinical case reporting to be complete for the purposes of this analysis. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1). Facilities were in urban and semiurban regions and consisted of 4 plants in Charlotte, 3 plants each in Cary and Raleigh, and 1 plant each in Asheville, Chapel Hill, Greensboro, Greenville, North Durham, and South Durham. During the study period, 45 confirmed mpox cases occurred within the included sewersheds. We excluded sites sampled through CDC-contracted programs (Verily, https://verily.com) and WastewaterSCAN (https://www.wastewaterscan.org) because of differences in laboratory methods, assays, reporting structures, and sampling frequency. Clinical Case Data We also obtained clinical case data from NCDHHS. A confirmed mpox case was defined according to the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022 (22-ID-10) as detection of nonvariola orthopoxvirus or MPXV DNA in a clinical specimen by PCR in a patient with compatible symptoms (11). We defined case date as date of symptom onset. We geocoded cases using residential address and spatially assigned them to sewersheds by using ArcGIS Pro (Esri, https://www.esri.com). Wastewater Sample Collection and Laboratory Testing. Influent wastewater was collected as 24-hour composite samples approximately 1 time/week at each WWTP except for the 3 plants in Cary and those in Chapel Hill, North Durham, and South Durham, which were only sampled selectively over the study period, generally in response to concerns about a confirmed or suspected mpox case in the general area. Samples were transported on ice and processed within 24 hours at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. We quantified MPXV DNA using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test (12). We originally optimized the assay in a wastewater matrix by conducting a thermal gradient from 62°C–52°C to see which annealing temperature resulted in the greatest separation from positive and negative droplet clusters (Appendix Figure). We reported results as viral gene copies normalized to flow rate and population within the sewershed. We classified samples with concentrations above the assay limit of detection (LOD) as positive (n = 17). We experimentally determined the assay limit of blank (LOB) to be 0 copies/L by using methods adapted from Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute document EP17 (13). Because the LOB was 0, we theoretically estimated the assay LOD to be 500 copies/L, because Poisson distribution requires roughly 3 copies per sample to detect >1 copies with 95% probability (14,15). Using this strategy, we classified samples with concentrations from one half the LOD to the LOD as trace detections (n = 30). Overall Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, and NPV We classified wastewater observations as positive or negative on the basis of laboratory results, as described previously. For each wastewater sample, the presence of >1 confirmed clinical case within +17 days in the same sewershed was assessed. We selected a +17-day alignment window to approximate the biologically plausible period during which MPXV might be detectable in wastewater relative to a reported clinical case. Available data suggest that viral shedding is most likely to occur at 4 to 25 days (16,17) and might begin before diagnosis. Additional delays related to seeking care, laboratory confirmation, case reporting, and wastewater sampling can create temporal offsets between infection and detection. We selected the +17-day window to balance those biological and operational considerations while minimizing misclassification. We defined diagnostic categories as follows: true positive (TP), wastewater-positive and >1 clinical case within +17 days; false positive (FP), wastewater-positive and no clinical case within +17 days; true negative (TN), wastewater-negative and no clinical case within +17 days; and false negative (FN), wastewater-negative and >1 clinical case within +17 days. We calculated sensitivity (TP/[TP + FN]), specificity (TN/[TN + FP]), PPV (TP/[TP + FP]), and NPV (TN/[TN + FN]) overall and stratified results by WWTP/sewershed catchment. We calculated 95% CIs using Wilson score intervals because several sites had small denominators and proportions near 0 or 1. The primary analysis classified both positive and trace detections as wastewater-positive (n = 47). A secondary sensitivity analysis restricted wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17). Because clinical case surveillance is an imperfect reference standard and does not capture all infections, TP/FP/TN/FN classifications should be interpreted as concordance with reported cases rather than true infection status. All analyses were conducted in R version 4.2.3 (The R Project for Statistical Computing, https://www.r-project.org). During October 29, 2023–May 31, 2025, a total of 801 wastewater samples were collected across 16 WWTPs serving an estimated population of ≈2 million people. Of those, 47 (5.9%) were classified as wastewater-positive (17 above the LOD and 30 trace detections) and 754 (94.1%) were wastewater-negative. During the same period, 45 confirmed mpox cases were reported that fell within sewersheds representing the WWTPs in this study. Using a +17-day temporal alignment window, we classified 15 wastewater observations as TPs, 32 as FPs, 627 as TNs, and 127 as FNs (Table 2). The overall sensitivity of wastewater detection identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned reported mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%). Specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%). The PPV was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and the NPV was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). At the WWTP sewershed level, sensitivity was highest at Charlotte WWTP 2 (25.0%) and ranged from 0% to 25.0% across sites with clinical activity (Table 3). Several sewersheds had no temporally aligned clinical cases during the surveillance period, resulting in undefined sensitivity estimates. Specificity was consistently high across sites, ranging from 71.4% to 100%. PPV varied widely by facility, ranging from <1% to 100%, reflecting differences in case occurrence and sampling frequency. NPV exceeded 69% at all sites with clinical activity and was 100% at several facilities without aligned cases. When restricting wastewater-positive observations to samples exceeding the LOD (n = 17), sensitivity decreased from 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%) to 1.4% (95% CI 0.4%–5.0%), and specificity increased from 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%) to 97.7% (95% CI 96.3%–98.6%) (Table 2). The number of FP observations decreased from 32 to 15, whereas FN observations increased from 127 to 140. PPV decreased from 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%) to 11.8% (95% CI 3.3%–34.3%), and NPV was similar (83.2% vs. 82.1%). Site-level performance patterns were unchanged. This evaluation assessed the performance of wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV across 16 WWTPs in North Carolina during October 2023–May 2025. Using a +17-day alignment window, wastewater detection demonstrated low sensitivity for identifying temporally aligned clinical cases (10.6% overall when including trace detections and 1.4% when restricted to detections above the LOD) but high specificity (>95%) and moderate NPV of ≈83%. We selected a +17-day window to account for the expected duration of MPXV shedding and potential delays between symptom onset, clinical diagnosis, and case reporting, while also accommodating once-weekly wastewater sampling. Because wastewater represents a composite, time-integrated signal and samples are collected weekly, this window reduces misclassification that could arise from temporal offsets between individual infections and wastewater detection. Those findings compare with national estimates reported in another study (16) that observed a daily sensitivity of 13.8% for detecting >1 person shedding MPXV and a weekly sensitivity of 31.7%. The lower sensitivity observed in North Carolina likely reflects differences in analytic approach, case density, and assumptions about viral shedding. Adams et al. (16) assumed complete case ascertainment and uniform 25-day viral shedding after symptom onset of mpox, whereas our analysis relied on confirmed case onset dates and a fixed +17-day temporal alignment window. This approach likely provides a more conservative estimate of sensitivity because wastewater detections occurring outside the defined window were classified as discordant even if they reflected prolonged or presymptomatic shedding. In addition, only 45 cases were identified across a population of >2 million persons, limiting the probability that wastewater concentrations would exceed detection thresholds. Despite low sensitivity for detecting single cases, specificity was high (95%–98%), indicating that wastewater-negative observations were generally concordant with the absence of reported cases. The NPV exceeded 80% overall and was higher at several individual sites, suggesting that the absence of a wastewater detection was associated with a low likelihood of concurrent reported cases. However, the PPV was modest (31.9% in the primary analysis and 11.8% in the LOD-only analysis), reflecting that some wastewater detections occurred without temporally aligned reported cases. Such detections could represent travel-associated cases, delayed reporting, prolonged shedding, asymptomatic or subclinical infections, or infections among persons residing outside the mapped catchment area. As a consequence, wastewater detections occurring without temporally aligned reported cases should not necessarily be interpreted as analytical FPs and might indicate true but unrecognized infections, suggesting that PPV might be underestimated. Therefore, if even a subset of those observations represented true infections, the PPV of wastewater surveillance would be higher than estimated in this analysis. Of note, sensitivity increased substantially when trace detections were included, indicating that low-level signals contributed meaningfully to temporal concordance with reported cases. That finding underscores the tradeoff between sensitivity and specificity when defining wastewater-positive thresholds. Restricting classification to concentrations above the assay LOD generally increased specificity but markedly reduced sensitivity, potentially limiting early warning capacity in low-incidence settings. In North Carolina, trace detections are interpreted within a structured public health decision framework rather than as definitive evidence of transmission and might prompt notification of local health departments and wastewater partners, review of recent case activity, enhanced syndromic surveillance monitoring, and coordination regarding case investigation or specimen retesting. Those actions are consistent with our public health action decision tree for confirmed detections (Figure). Confirmed detections might also involve escalation actions such as broader public notification, targeted outreach, and intensified sampling. Several factors likely contributed to the low sensitivity observed. First, mpox incidence during the study period was low and sporadic, reducing the probability that viral shedding might be detectable within large, pooled wastewater catchments. Second, sampling occurred once per week, which might have missed transient shedding signals. Third, wastewater represents an aggregate population-level signal, and the dilution effect within large catchments (some serving >500,000 persons) might limit detection of individual infections. Fourth, alignment relied on residential address assignment; persons infected but not residing within the sewershed would reduce measured concordance. The first limitation of this study is that reported clinical cases are not a perfect standard for infection. Our intent was to quantify the extent to which wastewater detections were temporally aligned with reported clinical cases within the same sewershed, rather than to provide an estimate of the true diagnostic accuracy of wastewater surveillance for detecting infection. papers.abstract_original: We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Early work demonstrated that viral shedding through urine, feces, respiratory secretions, and skin lesions can result in detectable MPXV in wastewater, supporting wastewater-based epidemiology as a viable approach for monitoring and quantifying community transmission (2,7,8). In 1 study, MPXV detections in wastewater were shown to precede the identification of the clinical cases, highlighting its potential for early outbreak detection (9). Another study reported increases in wastewater viral concentrations ahead of reported clinical cases (5). To evaluate mpox wastewater surveillance program in North Carolina, we conducted this study to estimate sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) relative to confirmed clinical cases. Study Area and Surveillance Period We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance analysis to evaluate wastewater surveillance for detecting MPXV circulation in North Carolina. The study included data from 16 publicly owned wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) with defined catchment areas serving a combined population of 2,002,864 persons (Table 1). papers.title_original: Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of wastewater surveillance for detecting mpox virus in North Carolina, USA, given the increasing public health concern associated with mpox since its emergence in a nonendemic region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted across 16 wastewater treatment plants serving approximately 2 million residents in North Carolina from October 2023 to May 2025. A total of 801 samples were collected during this period.
analysis.methods: MPXV DNA was quantified using the CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test. The assay was optimized in a wastewater matrix by testing thermal gradients from 62°C to 52°C. The limit of detection (LOD) was theoretically estimated at 500 copies/L based on Poisson distribution principles. A confirmed mpox case was defined by the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists case definition from 2022.
analysis.main_results: Overall, 17 wastewater samples were classified as positive, with sensitivity decreasing from 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%) to 1.4% (95% CI 0.4%–5.0%) when restricted to concentrations above the LOD. Specificity increased from 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%) to 97.7% (95% CI 96.3%–98.6%) under the same restriction. The number of false positives decreased from 32 to 15, while false negatives increased from 127 to 140.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that wastewater-based surveillance can provide complementary awareness for public health response, but its low sensitivity for detecting single cases indicates potential limitations in early warning capacity. The study highlights the importance of considering trace detections for temporal concordance with reported cases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results support the use of wastewater surveillance as a tool for monitoring community transmission trends of mpox virus, particularly in low-incidence settings, while emphasizing the need for complementary clinical surveillance to improve detection accuracy.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges that clinical case surveillance is an imperfect reference standard and does not capture all infections. The low sensitivity and variable positive predictive value (PPV) suggest that wastewater detections may not always reflect true infection status, and the evidence is moderate due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of wastewater surveillance for detecting mpox virus in North Carolina, USA, from October 2023 to May 2025. A total of 801 samples were collected from 16 treatment plants serving 2 million residents. The CDC Non-variola Orthopoxvirus Generic Real-Time PCR Test was used to quantify MPXV DNA, with a theoretical limit of detection (LOD) of 500 copies/L. Overall, 17 samples were classified as positive, showing low sensitivity (10.6%) but high specificity (>95%). When restricted to concentrations above the LOD, sensitivity dropped to 1.4%, and specificity increased to 97.7%. The study highlights that wastewater-based detection can provide complementary awareness for public health response but may miss many cases due to low sensitivity. The findings suggest that trace detections contribute meaningfully to temporal concordance with reported cases, and the absence of wastewater detection is associated with a low likelihood of concurrent reported cases. However, the study notes that the positive predictive value (PPV) was modest, indicating that some wastewater detections may not align with reported cases and could represent true but unrecognized infections. The evidence is moderate due to the limitations of using clinical case surveillance as a reference standard.

papers.title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
papers.abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the urgent public-health need for rapid, accurate diagnostic tools to mitigate the global outbreak risk of mpox, highlighting that existing methods are slow and deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class skin lesion classification.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors developed and evaluated a deep learning framework (HECA-YOLOv11) designed for real-time screening of mpox and similar skin lesions using a four-class image dataset.
analysis.methods: The proposed architecture integrates a Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11, applying Global Average Pooling and Max Average Pooling to input feature maps, and augments a dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements.
analysis.main_results: On the test set, HECA-YOLOv11 achieved 98.9% accuracy, 99% precision, 99.3% recall, and 99.1% F1-score, outperforming EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, YOLOv11s, SE-YOLOv11, and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all metrics.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques as effectively addressing key limitations in automated skin lesion detection, marking a major advancement toward reliable clinical decision support for early mpox screening.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The standardized interface and high performance of HECA-YOLOv11 suggest potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases through early detection.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report dataset size, geographic or demographic scope, external validation, or prospective clinical evaluation, limiting generalisability and leaving the strength of evidence moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces HECA-YOLOv11, a deep learning framework that integrates a Highly Efficient Channel Attention mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve real-time detection of mpox skin lesions. Using a four-class dataset augmented with spatial and pixel-domain enhancements, the model achieved 98.9% accuracy, 99% precision, 99.3% recall, and 99.1% F1-score on the test set, outperforming multiple baselines by over 5.1% across all metrics. Heatmap analysis via Grad-CAM confirmed lesion-focused attention, and a PyQt5 interface was developed to streamline clinical workflows. The authors argue this represents a major advancement toward reliable clinical decision support for early mpox screening and could accelerate public health responses. However, the abstract-only evidence lacks dataset size, external validation, and prospective clinical evaluation, constraining generalisability and evidence strength.

papers.title: Characterisation of host cytokine responses to mpox infection and their restrictive capacity
papers.abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is an orthopoxvirus (OPXV) that re-emerged in 2022 causing significant morbidity worldwide. Mpox disease presents with characteristic skin lesions and systemic inflammatory symptoms. Little is known about how MPXV modulates human innate immunity and cytokine responses, although significant evasion is expected from knowledge obtained from other OPXV. In this study I show that MPXV infection of human keratinocytes results in an inflammatory cytokine response defined by elevated IL-6, IL-8, IL-11 and LIF that was not shared with other OPXV. Genetic manipulation revealed that cytokine induction is dependent on nucleic acid sensing and multiple transcription factors. Activation of human fibroblasts with these cytokines did not restrict viral replication despite activating STAT3. Conversely, activation with IL-1β, TNFα and IFNβ resulted in a reduction of viral foci and significant restriction of MPXV and VACV replication. Furthermore, comparative analysis of cytokine responses highlighted that IL-1β and TNFα upregulate a subset of the ISG proteome and restriction by IL-1β and TNFα was partially alleviated by JAK1/2 inhibitor ruxolitinib, indicating ISG-dependent antiviral activity. Further analysis highlighted that IFN restriction was partly mediated by the transmembrane protein family IFITM, consistent with restriction at the level of establishing infection. Spread assays revealed that IFITMs impair VACV spread, mediated by EEV and restrict viral titres of a range of OPXV. Surprisingly, our study determined that IFITM antagonism is a conserved feature of OPXV infection. Collectively, this work reveals that MPXV has evolved a distinctive interplay with human innate responses characterized by selective modulation of inflammatory and chemotactic signalling whilst retaining effective suppression of antiviral cytokines. Furthermore, preactivating cells with IFN revealed selective antagonism of restrictive ISG by OPXV, indicating that OPXV interactions with the ISG proteome provide a source of novel antiviral factors to be exploited for IFN-based antivirals.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the infection of human keratinocytes with MPXV and the analysis of cytokine responses. It also included activation of human fibroblasts with various cytokines to assess their effect on viral replication.
analysis.methods: MPXV infection of human keratinocytes was used to examine cytokine responses, and genetic manipulation was employed to determine the dependence of cytokine induction on nucleic acid sensing and transcription factors. The study also involved activation of human fibroblasts with cytokines to evaluate their impact on viral replication.
analysis.main_results: MPXV infection of human keratinocytes resulted in an inflammatory cytokine response defined by elevated IL-6, IL-8, IL-11 and LIF that was not shared with other OPXV. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings indicate that MPXV has evolved a distinctive interplay with human innate responses, characterised by selective modulation of inflammatory and chemotactic signalling while retaining effective suppression of antiviral cytokines.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the mechanisms of cytokine responses and their restrictive capacity against mpox virus, which could inform the development of IFN-based antivirals and improve understanding of viral pathogenesis.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the host cytokine responses to mpox virus infection and their restrictive capacity. The research aimed to characterise how MPXV modulates human innate immunity and cytokine responses, as little is known about this aspect. The study found that MPXV infection of human keratinocytes leads to an inflammatory cytokine response, including elevated IL-6, IL-8, IL-11, and LIF, which is distinct from other OPXV. Activation of human fibroblasts with IL-1β, TNFα, and IFNβ resulted in reduced viral foci and significant restriction of MPXV and VACV replication. Genetic manipulation revealed that cytokine induction depends on nucleic acid sensing and multiple transcription factors. The findings suggest that MPXV has evolved a unique interaction with human innate responses, selectively modulating inflammatory and chemotactic signals while suppressing antiviral cytokines. These results could inform the development of IFN-based antivirals and enhance understanding of viral pathogenesis. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, which may affect the generalisability of the findings, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the lack of in vivo data.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及MPXV感染人类角质形成细胞,并分析细胞因子反应。此外,还包括使用不同细胞因子激活人类成纤维细胞以评估其对病毒复制的影响。

Genetic manipulation revealed that cytokine induction is dependent on nucleic acid sensing and multiple transcription factors. Activation of human fibroblasts with these cytokines did not restrict viral replication despite activating STAT3. Conversely, activation with IL-1β, TNFα and IFNβ resulted in a reduction of viral foci and significant restriction of MPXV and VACV replication. Furthermore, comparative analysis of cytokine responses highlighted that IL-1β and TNFα upregulate a subset of the ISG proteome and restriction by IL-1β and TNFα was partially alleviated by JAK1/2 inhibitor ruxolitinib, indicating ISG-dependent antiviral activity. Further analysis highlighted that IFN restriction was partly mediated by the transmembrane protein family IFITM, consistent with restriction at the level of establishing infection. Spread assays revealed that IFITMs impair VACV spread, mediated by EEV and restrict viral titres of a range of OPXV. Surprisingly, our study determined that IFITM antagonism is a conserved feature of OPXV infection. Collectively, this work reveals that MPXV has evolved a distinctive interplay with human innate responses characterized by selective modulation of inflammatory and chemotactic signalling whilst retaining effective suppression of antiviral cytokines. Furthermore, preactivating cells with IFN revealed selective antagonism of restrictive ISG by OPXV, indicating that OPXV interactions with the ISG proteome provide a source of novel antiviral factors to be exploited for IFN-based antivirals.
papers.abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒(MPXV)是一种正痘病毒(正痘病毒)在2022年重新出现,导致全球范围内显著的发病率。猴痘疾病表现为特征性的皮肤病变和系统性炎症症状。目前对MPXV如何调节人类先天免疫和细胞因子反应了解甚少,尽管从其他正痘病毒中获得的知识表明其可能具有显著的逃逸能力。本研究显示,MPXV感染人类角质形成细胞会导致以IL-6、IL-8、IL-11和LIF升高为特征的炎症细胞因子反应,这种反应与其他正痘病毒不同。基因操作揭示了细胞因子诱导依赖于核酸感应和多种转录因子。尽管这些细胞因子激活了人类成纤维细胞并激活了STAT3,但并未限制病毒复制。相反,使用IL-1β、TNFα和IFNβ激活细胞则导致病毒焦点减少,并显著限制了MPXV和VACV的复制。此外,对细胞因子反应的比较分析表明,IL-1β和TNFα上调了一部分ISG蛋白组,并且IL-1β和TNFα的限制作用部分被JAK1/2抑制剂鲁索替尼缓解,表明ISG依赖的抗病毒药物活性。进一步分析表明,IFN的限制作用部分由跨膜蛋白家族IFITM介导,这与在建立感染水平上的限制一致。传播实验显示,IFITMs通过EEV机制抑制VACV的传播,并限制多种正痘病毒的病毒滴度。令人惊讶的是,我们的研究确定IFITM拮抗是正痘病毒感染的一个保守特征。总体而言,这项工作揭示了MPXV与人类先天反应之间演化出的独特相互作用,其特点是选择性调节炎症和趋化信号传导,同时有效抑制抗病毒药物细胞因子。此外,预激活细胞与IFN显示OPXV对限制性ISG的特异性拮抗,表明OPXV与ISG蛋白组的相互作用为IFN基抗病毒药物提供了新的抗病毒药物因素。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在表征宿主细胞因子对猴痘感染的反应,并研究其限制能力。猴痘病毒(MPXV)是一种正痘病毒(正痘病毒),在2022年重新出现,导致全球范围内显著的发病率。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及MPXV感染人类角质形成细胞,并分析细胞因子反应。此外,还包括使用不同细胞因子激活人类成纤维细胞以评估其对病毒复制的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 利用MPXV感染人类角质形成细胞来研究细胞因子反应,并采用基因操作来确定细胞因子诱导对核酸感应和转录因子的依赖性。研究还涉及使用细胞因子激活人类成纤维细胞,以评估其对病毒复制的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: MPXV感染人类角质形成细胞导致以IL-6、IL-8、IL-11和LIF升高为特征的炎症细胞因子反应,这种反应与其他正痘病毒不同。使用IL-1β、TNFα和IFNβ激活细胞导致病毒焦点减少,并显著限制了MPXV和VACV的复制。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,MPXV已演化出与人类先天反应的独特相互作用,其特点是选择性调节炎症和趋化信号传导,同时有效抑制抗病毒药物细胞因子。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究提供了关于细胞因子反应及其对猴痘病毒限制机制的见解,这可能有助于开发基于IFN的抗病毒药物,并提高对病毒发病机制的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于体外实验,未考虑体内条件,这可能限制研究结果的普遍适用性。证据强度中等,因为其来源于一项研究,且生物背景有限。

papers.abstract: Following the discontinuation of routine smallpox vaccination and the emergence of mpox outbreaks, immunity against orthopoxviruses has received renewed attention. This study characterized immune responses among individuals with historical smallpox vaccination. Separately, an exploratory mathematical model was used to assess hypothetical transmission scenarios among immunocompromised populations. Cellular and humoral immune responses following historical smallpox vaccination were assessed using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay and enzyme-linked immunospot assay. Associations between clinical characteristics, laboratory markers, and immune responses were evaluated using regression analyses. An exploratory susceptible-infected-recovered-dead model based on published epidemiological parameters was used to assess hypothetical transmission scenarios among immunocompromised populations. Analysis included 112 peripheral blood mononuclear cell and 3,202 serum samples. Cellular immune responses were limited among individuals with historical smallpox vaccination, with no significant differences observed between healthy and disease groups. Vaccinated individuals with comorbidities had lower vaccinia virus Tianan strain-specific immunoglobulin G titers than the healthy group ( P < 0.001), with variations observed across chronic disease subgroups. The proportion of individuals with negative neutralizing antibody responses decreased with age but was higher among disease groups than in the healthy group. Chronic disease (odds ratio [OR], 0.67; 95% CI, 0.44–0.98) and cancer (OR, 0.58; 95% CI, 0.37–0.90) were associated with lower odds of high antibody positivity. High-density lipoprotein cholesterol and aspartate aminotransferase levels were positively associated with antibody levels, whereas cholinesterase showed an inverse association. Exploratory modeling under hypothetical scenarios suggested differences in simulated infection and mortality patterns among immunocompromised populations, with higher simulated infection proportions in individuals aged 15–19 years and higher mortality proportions in those aged ≥ 70 years. Individuals with historical smallpox vaccination showed detectable residual immune responses, with variations observed across comorbidity groups and in association with laboratory markers. Immunocompromised individuals may warrant further evaluation for potential orthopoxvirus susceptibility. These findings may inform future orthopoxvirus preparedness and prevention strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates residual immune responses in individuals with historical smallpox vaccination and explores outbreak modeling in immunocompromised populations. The research was motivated by the discontinuation of routine smallpox vaccination and the rise of mpox outbreaks, aiming to understand immunity against orthopoxviruses. The study design included an exploratory mathematical model and analysis of 112 peripheral blood mononuclear cell and 3,202 serum samples. Immune responses were measured using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay and enzyme-linked immunospot assay, with regression analyses assessing associations between clinical characteristics, laboratory markers, and immune responses. Results showed that the proportion of individuals with negative neutralizing antibody responses decreased with age but was higher among disease groups than in the healthy group. Chronic disease and cancer were associated with lower odds of high antibody positivity, while high-density lipoprotein cholesterol and aspartate aminotransferase levels were positively associated with antibody levels. The findings suggest that immunocompromised individuals may be more susceptible to orthopoxviruses and that residual immunity from historical vaccination varies across comorbidity groups. The study's implications highlight the need for further evaluation of orthopoxvirus susceptibility in immunocompromised populations, though the evidence strength is moderate due to the exploratory nature of the modeling and reliance on historical vaccination data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在常规天花疫苗接种停止以及猴痘 暴发出现后,针对正痘病毒的免疫力再次受到关注。本研究对具有历史天花疫苗接种记录的个体中免疫应答进行了特征描述。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 基于已发表的流行病学参数,采用探索性数学模型评估了免疫缺陷人群中假设的传播情景。分析包括112份外周血单核细胞和3,202份血清样本。
elements_zh.methods: 通过酶联免疫吸附试验和酶联免疫斑点试验评估了历史天花疫苗接种后细胞和体液中的免疫应答。利用回归分析评估了临床特征、实验室指标与免疫应答之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: The proportion of individuals with negative neutralizing antibody responses decreased with age but was higher among disease groups than in the healthy group. Chronic disease (odds ratio [OR], 0.67; 95% CI, 0.44–0.98) and cancer (OR, 0.58; 95% CI, 0.37–0.90) were associated with lower odds of high antibody positivity. High-density lipoprotein cholesterol and aspartate aminotransferase levels were positively associated with antibody levels, whereas cholinesterase showed an inverse association.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 具有历史天花疫苗接种记录的个体显示出可检测的残余免疫应答,不同合并症组之间存在差异,并且与实验室指标相关。在假设情景下的探索性建模表明,免疫缺陷人群中模拟感染和死亡率模式存在差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来的正痘病毒应对和预防策略提供信息。免疫缺陷个体可能需要进一步评估其对潜在正痘病毒的易感性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究设计或统计分析的具体局限性。由于建模的探索性质和对历史疫苗接种数据的关注,证据强度中等。

Ampofi Department of Mathematical Sciences, University of Mines and Technology, Tarkwa, Ghana Corresponding Author: [email protected] Article Information: Journal: International Journal of Advances in Applied Mathematics and Mechanics (IJAAMM) Volume: 14, Issue: 1, Pages: 108-121 Issue Date: September 2026 License: CC BY 4.0 DOI: https://doi.org/10.26541/ijaamm.2026.140110 Article History: Received 2026-06-22 00:00:00, Revised 2026-08-14 00:00:00, Accepted 2026-08-25 00:00:00, Published online 27 August 2026 Cite: D.A. Arhinful, A.Y. Anafo, I. Ampofi , Stability and sensitivity analysis of transmission dynamics of Mpox virus, Int. J. Adv. Appl. Math. and Mech. 14(1) (2026) 108-121. https://doi.org/10.26541/ijaamm.2026.140110 Abstract A deterministic compartmental model is formulated for Mpox transmission dynamics in interacting human and rodent populations. The human population is divided into susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered classes; the rodent population into susceptible, exposed, and infectious classes. A quarantined-to-susceptible pathway is incorporated to capture undetected cases re-entering the at-risk population. The basic reproduction number $R_{0}$ is derived using the next-generation matrix method. Local asymptotic stability of the disease-free equilibrium is established whenever $R_{0}<1$, and global asymptotic stability is proved using the Castillo-Chavez and Song approach. Routh-Hurwitz conditions are also derived for the endemic equilibrium. Normalised forward sensitivity analysis identifies the human-to-human rate and proportion of exposed humans to infected class as the dominant drivers of transmission; increasing recovery and treatment rates reduces $R_0$. Numerical simulations confirm that all infectious compartments decline asymptotically to zero when $R_{0}<1$, consistent with disease elimination. These results offer a quantitative basis for designing targeted Mpox control interventions, particularly through contact reduction and improved treatment coverage. Keywords Mpox; Deterministic model; Basic reproduction number; Disease-free equilibrium; Stability analysis; Sensitivity analysis; Next-generation matrix; Routh-Hurwitz criterion MSC (2020) 92D30; 34D20

papers.title_original: Stability and sensitivity analysis of transmission dynamics of Mpox virus

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus through stability and sensitivity analysis to understand the factors influencing its spread and inform control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A deterministic compartmental model was formulated to study Mpox transmission dynamics in both human and rodent populations, incorporating classes such as susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered for humans, and susceptible, exposed, and infectious for rodents.
analysis.methods: The study used a deterministic compartmental model with compartments for susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered human populations, and susceptible, exposed, and infectious rodent populations. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was calculated using the next-generation matrix method, and stability of equilibria was analyzed using Castillo-Chavez and Song approach as well as Routh-Hurwitz conditions.
analysis.main_results: The results showed that the disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable when $R_0 < 1$, and global asymptotic stability is achieved under the same condition. Numerical simulations confirmed that all infectious compartments decline asymptotically to zero when $R_0 < 1$, indicating disease elimination.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the human-to-human transmission rate and the proportion of exposed humans moving to the infectious class are the dominant drivers of Mpox transmission. They also noted that increasing recovery and treatment rates can reduce $R_0$, offering a quantitative basis for targeted interventions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a quantitative framework for designing targeted Mpox control interventions, particularly by focusing on reducing contact rates and improving treatment coverage to lower the basic reproduction number.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a deterministic model, which assumes no randomness in transmission dynamics. The evidence is strong as it uses mathematical methods and simulations to support its conclusions, but the model's assumptions may limit its applicability to real-world scenarios.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a deterministic compartmental model to analyze the transmission dynamics of Mpox virus in human and rodent populations. The model incorporates compartments for susceptible, exposed, infectious, quarantined, and recovered individuals, with stability analysis of disease-free and endemic equilibria. The basic reproduction number $R_0$ was calculated using the next-generation matrix method, and the results indicate that $R_0 < 1$ leads to disease elimination. The authors identified human-to-human transmission rate and proportion of exposed humans to infectious class as key drivers of spread, emphasizing the importance of contact reduction and improved treatment coverage. The study's findings offer a quantitative basis for targeted control strategies. However, the deterministic nature of the model may limit its real-world applicability. The evidence is strong, supported by mathematical analysis and simulations, but the model's assumptions could affect generalizability.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过稳定性和敏感性分析来分析 传播 的动态,以了解影响其传播的因素并为控制策略提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 建立了一个确定性分层模型来研究猴痘在人类和啮齿类动物种群中的动态变化,模型中包含了人类的易感、暴露、感染、隔离和康复等类别,以及啮齿类动物的易感、暴露和感染等类别。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用了一个确定性分层模型,包括人类的易感、暴露、感染、隔离和康复等状态,以及啮齿类动物的易感、暴露和感染等状态。基本再生数 $R_0$ 通过下一代矩阵方法计算,平衡点的稳定性则通过Castillo-Chavez和Song的方法以及Routh-Hurwitz条件进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,当 $R_0 < 1$ 时,无病平衡点是局部渐近稳定的,且在相同条件下达到全局渐近稳定。数值模拟进一步证实,当 $R_0 < 1$ 时,所有感染状态都会渐近地衰减至零,表明疾病可以被消除。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,人类之间的传播传播率以及暴露人类进入感染类别的比例是猴痘传播的主要驱动因素。他们还指出,提高康复率和治疗率可以降低 $R_0$,为有针对性的干预措施提供了定量依据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为设计针对性的猴痘控制干预措施提供了定量框架,特别是通过减少接触率和提高治疗覆盖率来降低基本再生数。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于一个确定性模型,假设传播动态变化中没有随机性。其证据强度较高,因为使用了数学方法和模拟来支持结论,但模型的假设可能限制了其在现实场景中的适用性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过稳定性和敏感性分析来分析 传播 的动态,以了解影响其传播的因素并为控制策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 建立了一个确定性分层模型来研究猴痘在人类和啮齿类动物种群中的动态变化,模型中包含了人类的易感、暴露、感染、隔离和康复等类别,以及啮齿类动物的易感、暴露和感染等类别。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究采用了一个确定性分层模型,包括人类的易感、暴露、感染、隔离和康复等状态,以及啮齿类动物的易感、暴露和感染等状态。基本再生数 $R_0$ 通过下一代矩阵方法计算,平衡点的稳定性则通过Castillo-Chavez和Song的方法以及Routh-Hurwitz条件进行分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究结果表明,当 $R_0 < 1$ 时,无病平衡点是局部渐近稳定的,且在相同条件下达到全局渐近稳定。数值模拟进一步证实,当 $R_0 < 1$ 时,所有感染状态都会渐近地衰减至零,表明疾病可以被消除。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,人类之间的传播传播率以及暴露人类进入感染类别的比例是猴痘传播的主要驱动因素。他们还指出,提高康复率和治疗率可以降低 $R_0$,为有针对性的干预措施提供了定量依据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为设计针对性的猴痘控制干预措施提供了定量框架,特别是通过减少接触率和提高治疗覆盖率来降低基本再生数。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于一个确定性模型,假设传播动态变化中没有随机性。其证据强度较高,因为使用了数学方法和模拟来支持结论,但模型的假设可能限制了其在现实场景中的适用性。

papers.title: Risk communication strategies during public health emergencies: a narrative review of frameworks, recent crises, and emerging challenges
papers.abstract: Public health emergencies, ranging from infectious disease outbreaks to climate-driven and humanitarian crises, generate communication demands that conventional health messaging often fails to meet. Risk communication is increasingly recognized as a determinant of population behavior, healthcare system burden, and ultimately morbidity and mortality during crises. The COVID-19 pandemic exposed substantial limitations in existing approaches, particularly regarding transparency, equity, and the management of information overload, and major retrospective assessments have characterized the global response as a systemic failure across multiple coordinated domains, of which communication is one. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on risk communication during public health emergencies, based on an iterative search of MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, Google Scholar, and grey literature from major public health agencies covering 2018 to 2026. The synthesis is organized around three axes. Established frameworks are compared, including Crisis and Emergency Risk Communication, the World Health Organization guidance on emergency risk communication, and emerging community-centered and equity-focused models, with attention to how they complement, overlap with, and diverge from one another. Lessons are then drawn from recent crises, including the pre-vaccine phase of the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2022 and 2024 mpox outbreaks, and the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Persistent challenges are examined last, encompassing the infodemic, erosion of institutional trust, inequities in message reach, the dual role of digital, social, and traditional media, and the behavioral responses mediating the effects of messaging. Risk communication cannot be evaluated in isolation from the coordinated emergency response of which it forms a part, and is better understood as a transversal function serving every component of that response. Frameworks remain heavily centered on high-income contexts, transparency about uncertainty is often sacrificed for the appearance of authority, and systematic evaluation of intervention effectiveness is scarce. Emergency departments represent one important operational interface among several coordinated levels of the response rather than the sole communication setting. Future work should prioritize community-engaged interventions in low- and middle-income settings, cross-fertilization with behavioral epidemiology and public health ethics, and metrics capturing both the equity and the quality of communication outcomes.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on risk communication strategies during public health emergencies, particularly examining the Mpox virus and its associated disease. The central question is how effective communication can be during outbreaks, with an emphasis on transparency, equity, and managing information overload.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis based on an iterative search of MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, Google Scholar, and grey literature from major public health agencies, covering the period from 2018 to 2026. It includes evidence from recent crises such as the pre-vaccine phase of the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2022 and 2024 mpox outbreaks, and the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that risk communication is a critical component of public health emergency responses and cannot be evaluated in isolation. It emphasizes the need for transversal functions that support all aspects of the emergency response, including the importance of community engagement and addressing equity in message reach.

papers.title_zh: 公共卫生紧急情况下的风险沟通策略:关于框架、近期危机和新兴挑战的叙述性综述
papers.source_body_en: Public health emergencies, ranging from infectious disease outbreaks to climate-driven and humanitarian crises, generate communication demands that conventional health messaging often fails to meet. Risk communication is increasingly recognized as a determinant of population behavior, healthcare system burden, and ultimately morbidity and mortality during crises. The COVID-19 pandemic exposed substantial limitations in existing approaches, particularly regarding transparency, equity, and the management of information overload, and major retrospective assessments have characterized the global response as a systemic failure across multiple coordinated domains, of which communication is one. This narrative review synthesizes evidence on risk communication during public health emergencies, based on an iterative search of MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, Google Scholar, and grey literature from major public health agencies covering 2018 to 2026. The synthesis is organized around three axes. Established frameworks are compared, including Crisis and Emergency Risk Communication, the World Health Organization guidance on emergency risk communication, and emerging community-centered and equity-focused models, with attention to how they complement, overlap with, and diverge from one another. Lessons are then drawn from recent crises, including the pre-vaccine phase of the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2022 and 2024 mpox outbreaks, and the 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Persistent challenges are examined last, encompassing the infodemic, erosion of institutional trust, inequities in message reach, the dual role of digital, social, and traditional media, and the behavioral responses mediating the effects of messaging. Risk communication cannot be evaluated in isolation from the coordinated emergency response of which it forms a part, and is better understood as a transversal function serving every component of that response. Frameworks remain heavily centered on high-income contexts, transparency about uncertainty is often sacrificed for the appearance of authority, and systematic evaluation of intervention effectiveness is scarce. Emergency departments represent one important operational interface among several coordinated levels of the response rather than the sole communication setting. Future work should prioritize community-engaged interventions in low- and middle-income settings, cross-fertilization with behavioral epidemiology and public health ethics, and metrics capturing both the equity and the quality of communication outcomes.

papers.title: High-Sensitivity Molecular Detection of Viral Bioaerosols Using a Composite Collection System and Optimized RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a.
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic airborne microorganisms pose a significant public health threat, particularly because their small particle size can support prolonged suspension and long-range transport. Here, we present an integrated platform that combines a composite bioaerosol collection system with a three-stage enrichment mechanism and recombinase polymerase amplification-CRISPR/Cas12a (RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a) detection. The platform incorporates model-based constant-temperature control, stacked optical filters, and multichannel fluorescence imaging. The temperature-control model accurately described the thermal response of the reaction module, while the optical and imaging subsystems supported stable fluorescence readout. Using aerosolized monkeypox virus (MPXV) pseudovirus as a controlled test target, the platform detected target nucleic acid in collection liquid down to 10 copies/μL under the tested conditions. These results support the feasibility of integrating aerosol enrichment with isothermal molecular detection in a compact prototype. The main contributions lie in innovations and the engineering integration of bioaerosol collection and enrichment, thermal control of biochemical reactions in molecular detection, and precision fluorescence detection techniques for molecular detection. Regarding molecular detection methods, the biochemical reaction parameters were experimentally optimized rather than introducing new biochemical reaction mechanisms. Validation with authentic clinical or environmental viral aerosols remains necessary before diagnostic or field-use claims can be made.

papers.title_zh: 使用复合采集系统和优化的RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a检测病毒生物气溶胶的高灵敏度分子检测
papers.source_body_en: Highly pathogenic airborne microorganisms pose a significant public health threat, particularly because their small particle size can support prolonged suspension and long-range transport. Here, we present an integrated platform that combines a composite bioaerosol collection system with a three-stage enrichment mechanism and recombinase polymerase amplification-CRISPR/Cas12a (RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a) detection. The platform incorporates model-based constant-temperature control, stacked optical filters, and multichannel fluorescence imaging. The temperature-control model accurately described the thermal response of the reaction module, while the optical and imaging subsystems supported stable fluorescence readout. Using aerosolized monkeypox virus (MPXV) pseudovirus as a controlled test target, the platform detected target nucleic acid in collection liquid down to 10 copies/μL under the tested conditions. These results support the feasibility of integrating aerosol enrichment with isothermal molecular detection in a compact prototype. The main contributions lie in innovations and the engineering integration of bioaerosol collection and enrichment, thermal control of biochemical reactions in molecular detection, and precision fluorescence detection techniques for molecular detection. Regarding molecular detection methods, the biochemical reaction parameters were experimentally optimized rather than introducing new biochemical reaction mechanisms. Validation with authentic clinical or environmental viral aerosols remains necessary before diagnostic or field-use claims can be made.
papers.abstract_zh: 高度致病的空气传播微生物对公共卫生构成重大威胁,特别是由于其微小的颗粒尺寸可以支持长时间悬浮和远距离传播。本文提出了一种集成平台,结合复合生物气溶胶采集系统、三阶段富集机制和重组酶聚合酶扩增-CRISPR/Cas12a(RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a)检测技术。该平台集成了基于模型的恒温控制、堆叠光学滤波器和多通道荧光成像系统。温度控制模型准确描述了反应模块的热响应,而光学和成像子系统支持稳定的荧光读取。使用气溶胶化的猴痘病毒(MPXV)假病毒作为受控测试目标,在测试条件下,该平台在采集液中检测到目标核酸的最低浓度为10 copies/μL。这些结果支持了在紧凑原型中整合气溶胶富集与等温分子检测的可行性。主要贡献在于生物气溶胶采集和富集的创新及工程整合、分子检测中生化反应的恒温控制以及高精度荧光检测技术。关于分子检测方法,生化反应参数是通过实验优化的,而不是引入新的生化反应机制。在做出诊断或现场应用声明之前,仍需使用真实的临床或环境病毒气溶胶进行验证。

papers.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Commercial Large Language Models for Anogenital Skin Lesion Images: A Comparative Study of Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Diagnosing anogenital dermatological conditions often requires specialist expertise that is unavailable in many clinical settings. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly accessible to clinicians, but their diagnostic accuracy for anogenital dermatology has not been evaluated. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of 3 LLMs (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.1, and ChatGPT 5 Thinking) for anogenital dermatological conditions. METHODS: This study was conducted between September and November 2025, using deidentified clinical images of anogenital conditions from the STI Atlas (stiatlas.org) and other publicly available sources. Primary outcomes were correct classification of images identified as sexually transmitted infections (STIs) vs non-STIs and the inclusion of the correct diagnosis among the LLMs' top-ranked (top-1), top-3, or top-5 differential diagnoses. RESULTS: Among 218 images, Gemini achieved the highest accuracy for STI binary classification (76.2% [95% CI, 70.5%-81.9%]) and differential diagnosis (top-1, 39.0% [95% CI, 32.7%-45.7%]; top-3, 54.6% [95% CI, 47.9%-61.1%]; top-5, 60.6% [95% CI, 53.9%-66.9%]), followed by ChatGPT and Claude. In subgroup analysis, all LLMs showed substantially reduced accuracy for diagnostically challenging images (top-5 accuracy range, 29.2%-40.0%). Gemini consistently outperformed Claude across most subgroups (P < .05). None of the LLMs could identify any mpox correctly. CONCLUSIONS: LLMs showed limited accuracy for diagnosing anogenital dermatological conditions, particularly for challenging images. The best-performing model (Gemini) achieved only 39.0% for top-1 diagnosis, indicating that current LLMs cannot reliably diagnose anogenital conditions. These tools may support supervised clinical triage but need further validation before routine clinical use. Future studies should compare LLMs with clinicians and explore how they can assist clinical diagnosis.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究于2025年9月至11月期间进行,使用了来自STI Atlas(stiatlas.org)和其他公开来源的去标识化肛周疾病临床图像。
elements_zh.methods: 主要结果是正确分类图像(识别为性传播感染[STI]与非STI)以及LLMs在最可能的(top-1)、top-3或top-5鉴别诊断中包含正确的诊断。
elements_zh.main_results: Among 218 images, Gemini achieved the highest accuracy for STI binary classification (76.2% [95% CI, 70.5%-81.9%]) and differential diagnosis (top-1, 39.0% [95% CI, 32.7%-45.7%]; top-3, 54.6% [95% CI, 47.9%-61.1%]; top-5, 60.6% [95% CI, 53.9%-66.9%]), followed by ChatGPT and Claude. elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: LLMs在肛周皮肤病诊断中的准确性有限,尤其是在具有挑战性的图像中。表现最好的模型(Gemini)在top-1 诊断中的准确性仅为39.0%,表明当前LLMs无法可靠地诊断肛周疾病。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些工具可能支持监督下的临床分诊,但在常规临床使用前需要进一步验证。未来的研究应将LLMs与临床医生进行比较,并探讨它们如何辅助临床诊断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未具体报告与猴痘病毒相关的局限性。研究结果表明,LLMs在肛周疾病诊断中的准确性具有中等信心,但证据仅限于STI的一般类别,并未聚焦于猴痘。

papers.title: Aligning Licensure and Recommended Use to Expedite Vaccine Access in Response to the Ongoing Bundibugyo Ebolavirus Epidemic in Central Africa
papers.abstract: The ongoing Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense—Bundibugyo virus (BDBV)—epidemic is the worst Ebolavirus outbreak in a decade and is rapidly expanding, with >4600 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) alone. It has caused 2186 deaths and spread to neighboring countries. As BDBV has no approved vaccine, timely response will require adapted use of existing vaccines approved for other ebolaviruses and expedited development of novel vaccines targeted toward BDBV. Access to vaccines is fundamental to public health emergency response and generally depends on two expert bodies in each country: a national regulatory authority (e.g., the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)) and a national immunization advisor. Receding traditional global health assistance compounds already-limited licensure and recommended use in the DRC and other low-income countries confronting recent outbreaks of Ebola, Marburg, and mpox, exacerbating access gaps for high-risk populations. This commentary thus clarifies the critical importance of a robust national immunization advisor, coordinated closely with expanded licensure, in expediting access to vaccines and other essential epidemic response tools. Using the regulatory responses of the Republic of Rwanda and DRC, it demonstrates that clearer delineation of roles between these bodies is critical for effective response, can help prioritize self-sufficiency and greater regional public health cooperation, and will thus enable swifter control of Bundibugyo.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the urgent need for improved vaccine access in response to the ongoing Bundibugyo Ebolavirus epidemic, which has caused significant public health concerns in Central Africa.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a commentary analyzing the regulatory and immunization frameworks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Rwanda, focusing on the challenges faced by low-income countries in accessing vaccines for emerging outbreaks.
analysis.methods: The authors examine the roles of national regulatory authorities and immunization advisors, using the DRC and Rwanda as case studies to highlight the importance of clear delineation of responsibilities in vaccine access and epidemic response.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that the DRC and Rwanda have experienced over 4600 suspected cases and 2186 deaths from the Bundibugyo virus, with the epidemic rapidly expanding and affecting neighboring countries.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the lack of an approved vaccine for BDBV necessitates the use of existing vaccines for other ebolaviruses and the development of novel ones, emphasizing the need for coordinated action between regulatory bodies and immunization advisors.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the critical role of national immunization advisors in expediting vaccine access and enhancing regional cooperation to control outbreaks of mpox and other related viruses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence and does not provide detailed statistical or methodological data, limiting the strength of its conclusions to a moderate level.

analysis.summary_en: This commentary addresses the urgent need for improved vaccine access in response to the ongoing Bundibugyo Ebolavirus epidemic in Central Africa. The study highlights the challenges faced by low-income countries in accessing vaccines for emerging outbreaks, focusing on the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Rwanda. It emphasizes the importance of clear delineation of roles between national regulatory authorities and immunization advisors to expedite vaccine access and enhance regional cooperation. The authors interpret that the lack of an approved vaccine for BDBV necessitates the use of existing vaccines for other ebolaviruses and the development of novel ones. The study underscores the critical role of national immunization advisors in public health emergency response. However, the study is based on abstract-only evidence, which limits the strength of its conclusions to a moderate level.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在应对持续爆发的邦迪布古埃博拉病毒疫情所引发的迫切需求,以改善疫苗的获取,该疫情已对中非地区的公共卫生造成重大影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项评论,分析刚果民主共和国(DRC)和卢旺达的监管与免疫框架,重点关注低收入国家在获取针对新兴暴发的疫苗过程中所面临的挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 作者研究了国家药品监管机构和免疫顾问的作用,以刚果民主共和国和卢旺达为案例,突出明确划分职责对于疫苗获取和疫情应对的重要性。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究指出,刚果民主共和国和卢旺达已出现超过4600例疑似病例和2186例死亡,疫情迅速扩散并影响邻国。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,由于BDBV尚无获批的疫苗,因此需要使用针对其他埃博拉病毒获批的疫苗,并开发新的疫苗,强调监管机构与免疫顾问之间协调行动的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果突显了国家免疫顾问在加快疫苗获取和增强区域合作以控制暴发及与其他相关病毒方面的重要作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于摘要内容,未提供详细统计数据或方法学数据,因此其结论的强度仅限于中等水平。

analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the lack of an approved vaccine for BDBV necessitates the use of existing vaccines for other ebolaviruses and the development of novel ones, emphasizing the need for coordinated action between regulatory bodies and immunization advisors.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the critical role of national immunization advisors in expediting vaccine access and enhancing regional cooperation to control outbreaks of mpox and other related viruses.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence and does not provide detailed statistical or methodological data, limiting the strength of its conclusions to a moderate level.

papers.title_zh: 协调许可与推荐使用以加快疫苗在中非持续爆发的邦迪布古埃博拉病毒疫情中的获取
papers.source_body_en: The ongoing Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense—Bundibugyo virus (BDBV)—epidemic is the worst Ebolavirus outbreak in a decade and is rapidly expanding, with >4600 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) alone. It has caused 2186 deaths and spread to neighboring countries. As BDBV has no approved vaccine, timely response will require adapted use of existing vaccines approved for other ebolaviruses and expedited development of novel vaccines targeted toward BDBV. Access to vaccines is fundamental to public health emergency response and generally depends on two expert bodies in each country: a national regulatory authority (e.g., the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)) and a national immunization advisor. Receding traditional global health assistance compounds already-limited licensure and recommended use in the DRC and other low-income countries confronting recent outbreaks of Ebola, Marburg, and mpox, exacerbating access gaps for high-risk populations. This commentary thus clarifies the critical importance of a robust national immunization advisor, coordinated closely with expanded licensure, in expediting access to vaccines and other essential epidemic response tools. Using the regulatory responses of the Republic of Rwanda and DRC, it demonstrates that clearer delineation of roles between these bodies is critical for effective response, can help prioritize self-sufficiency and greater regional public health cooperation, and will thus enable swifter control of Bundibugyo.
papers.abstract_zh: 持续爆发的正埃博拉病毒邦迪布古亚种(Bundibugyo virus,BDBV)疫情是十年来最严重的埃博拉病毒暴发疫情,且迅速扩散,仅在刚果民主共和国(DRC)就已出现超过4600例疑似病例。该疫情已导致2186人死亡,并传播至邻国。由于BDBV尚无获批的疫苗,及时应对将需要采用针对其他埃博拉病毒获批的疫苗,并加快开发针对BDBV的新疫苗。获取疫苗对于公共卫生紧急响应至关重要,通常依赖于每个国家的两个专家机构:国家药品监管机构(例如美国食品药品监督管理局(FDA))和国家免疫顾问。传统全球卫生援助的减少加剧了DRC及其他面临近期埃博拉、马尔堡和猴痘疫情的低收入国家在获得疫苗方面的有限许可和推荐使用,从而扩大了高危人群获取的差距。因此,本文评论强调了强大的国家免疫顾问与扩大许可协调的重要性,以加快疫苗及其他关键疫情应对工具的获取。通过分析卢旺达和DRC的监管应对,本文展示了这两个机构之间职责明确划分对于有效应对的重要性,有助于优先考虑自给自足和更广泛的区域公共卫生合作,并从而实现对邦迪布古疫情的更快控制。
